annotations.title: Monitor competitor prices, stock, and changelogs

description: Watch competitor stores and SaaS sites and return only what changed since the last run with the same state_key. Give sites as domains or URLs (for example deathwishcoffee.com, linear.app). Shopify stores are read from their public product feed and WooCommerce stores from their public Store API, so you get price, compare at price, and stock changes per variant, plus new and removed products. SaaS sites are read from the pricing and changelog pages they link to, so you get plans added, removed, or repriced, and new changelog entries. Every site gets one row per run (site_baseline on the first check, then site_check with changes_found), plus one row per change with old and new values. Unreadable sites come back free with a row_status saying so. A run that does not succeed is returned as an error with its run ID. Read-only; requires an APIFY_TOKEN; Apify charges per change row and per site check that is a first check or finds a change; an unchanged site is free.

changelog_urls.description: Changelog or release notes pages to read, when the site does not link to one from the homepage. An RSS or Atom feed the page declares is read first.

include_snapshot.description: true to also return one snapshot row per product variant, plan, and changelog entry on the first check of a site. Each snapshot row is billed as a snapshot row. Default false.

max_changes_per_site.description: Change rows returned per site per run, up to 1000. The rest are counted in changes_found. Default 200.

max_charge_usd.description: Optional. The run stops before it would charge more than this.

max_products.description: Products read from a store catalog per run, up to 5000. A store with more products than this is compared on the products read, and removed products are not reported for it. Default 250.

min_price_change_pct.description: Report a price change only when it is at least this many percent. 0 reports every change. Default 0.

pricing_urls.description: Pricing pages to read, when the site does not link to its pricing page from the homepage.

product_urls.description: Product pages on a store that is not Shopify or WooCommerce. Each page is read for its schema.org Product price and availability.

proxy_mode.description: auto (default) sends requests directly and moves a host to the Apify proxy default pool only when that host refuses. A reliability setting: proxy use adds nothing to your price.

reset_state.description: true to ignore the saved state and record a new baseline for every site. Default false.

site_type.description: auto (default) reads the public Shopify product feed or the WooCommerce Store API when the site has one, and otherwise reads the pricing and changelog pages it links to.

sites.description: Competitor sites to watch, one per line: a domain (deathwishcoffee.com, linear.app) or a URL. A URL with a path is read as that page: a pricing page, a changelog page, or a product page. Up to 200 sites per run.

state_key.description: Names the saved state, so separate schedules keep separate baselines. Runs with the same state key and site compare against each other.

watch.description: Any of: prices, stock, products, plans, changelog. prices covers price and compare at price per variant; stock covers in stock and out of stock; products covers new and removed products; plans covers plan names and prices on a pricing page; changelog covers new changelog entries. Empty means all five.
